_comment: Only people running Yapdev see these. Badges come from the built-in Yapdev set (see src/badgeIcons.js): boss, founder, dev, helper, earlybird, tester, bughunter, translator, themer, supporter, og, nightowl, yapper, cat. They are custom Yapdev badges, NOT official Yapper badges. "plus": true shows the cosmetic Fake Plus label (unlocks nothing). To add a custom badge, add it under "badges" with label, icon (one of the built-in icon names) and color.
